system.description: Also, at 3rd level, you have equipped yourself with a specially crafted prosthetic arm or gauntlet of your design and description. This prosthetic is fitted with hidden compartments that store different trick tools and weapons. This prosthetic begins with 2 Prosthetic Slots. Each prosthetic slot can be fitted with a Prosthetic Tool. You select two tools at 3rd level, and can select one additional tool at 7th, 10th and 14th levels. If your Prosthetic Tool requires an attack or Saving throw, you use your Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack/Save DC, your choice. Using your prosthetic tools can overwork and strain the prosthetic as a whole, limiting you to being able to use any tool within your prosthetic no more than 4 times every 10 minutes.

roll.note: No more than 4 times every 10 minutes.
